verses.1: And Elohim said, “I will do it.”
verses.2: Until Anah Togyon can heal my soul and comfort me with words.
verses.3: This is ten times that I was tempted to not be hurt, to not be recognized.
verses.4: And even though I was struck by them, they still managed to get away from me.
verses.5: If indeed you will increase my suffering and cause me to suffer humiliation.
verses.6: Know, O people, that the Lord has punished me, and He has given me a severe fate.
verses.7: I will also cry out, but no one will answer me. There is no justice at all.
verses.8: I will not go away, and darkness will be placed upon my paths.
verses.9: I am pleased that He has removed the covering from my head.
verses.10: They surrounded me, and I went away. They drove me away like a tree that has been cut down.
verses.11: And he attacked me with his fangs, and regarded me as one of his enemies.
verses.12: Together, they came and set up their tents around my tent.
verses.13: My brothers are far away from me, and I know that they are strangers to me.
verses.14: Their love and understanding have forgotten me.
verses.15: My servants and my women will consider me a stranger. I was considered a barbarian in their eyes.
verses.16: I called out to my servant, but he did not answer me with his own mouth.
verses.17: My spirit is foreign to my wife, and I have stored up treasures in my womb.
verses.18: Even the birds nest in my heart, and they speak to me.
verses.19: May all signs of evil be removed from me; may those things that I loved become nothing more than mere memories.
verses.20: In my words and deeds, I sought to be pure, and thus I was raised up in a place of purity.
verses.21: Hanani, Hananii! You are my enemies, for the hand of the Lord has touched me.
verses.22: Why do you chase me like an eagle? Do not stop pursuing me.
verses.23: Who will give them an envelope to write them in? Who will record them in the book and mark them accordingly?
verses.24: In iron and bronze, they will be forever cast into the abyss.
verses.25: And I know that my Lord lives, and he will rise from the dead.
verses.26: And after they have passed through those gates, I will hold them in my arms.
verses.27: For I have seen with my own eyes, and nothing is strange to me; all my desires are fulfilled according to the laws of God.
verses.28: For say, “What has been pursued by him? And what is the root of his words?”
verses.29: May it be a warning to you from the time of destruction, so that you may know what destruction is.
